question: What is the full form of "NDC'' a government agency?
solution:
The correct answer is__** the National Development Council**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The full form of "NDC" is **National Development Council (NDC)**
 
• This is a government agency in India that plays a crucial role in formulating and coordinating national development policies.
 
• It is chaired by the Prime Minister and includes representatives from various states and central ministries.
 
• National Development Council (NDC) is an executive body established by the Government of India in August 1952.
 
• It is also known as Rash
